subtitle: HNM fixed and variable-angle hydraulic corner notchers · SDK 6 / SDK 8 circular cutting and flanging machines · EFM 6 elliptical cutter · BT 114-S pipe polisher · SPB 60 / 76 NC pipe draw benders

about_title: The machines around the shear and the press brake
about_text: The machines in this catalogue are NovoTech's premium line: built in Turkey to NovoTech's specification by a CE-certified metal-forming plant with more than 40 years of machine building and exports to over 100 countries, with European hydraulic and electrical components, inspected before shipping, and sold under NovoTech's name with a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from NovoTech in Mississauga, Ontario.

The HNM hydraulic corner notchers cut the 90° and variable-angle notches that let a sheet fold into a box; the SDK 6 and SDK 8 cut and flange circular blanks and tank heads to Ø15 ft in 5/16″ plate and the EFM 6 does the same for elliptical heads; the BT 114-S polishes and sands round and square tube to a satin finish with a mobile pendant; and the SPB 60 and SPB 76 NC draw benders bend handrail and furniture tube around a die with a programmed sequence of bends. All with a CSA-approved panel, installed and supported from Mississauga.
